GameplayEvent Rules8 sections
Gameplay

◆ You can consume Stamina to support the performance during the event. Stamina regenerates over time: 1 point every 20 minutes. Each performance starts from Heat Level 0.

◆ Each performance has its Heat Levels. Each Heat Level requires different Heat Value. Players can increase Heat Value through supporting.

◆ You can increase the Support Value by deploying fans and support items. The higher the Support Value, the higher the Heat Level that can be achieved.

◆ You can get random rewards after each performance: fans, support items, and Performance Points. The higher the Heat Level, the higher the rewards.

◆ The 5x5 seating area can be deployed with fans and support items. Only one available seat by default. Unlock more seats to deploy additional fans and support items.

◆ Performance Points can also be obtained by removing excess fans, and they can be used to unlock seats or upgrade fans level.

◆ Deploy different fans and support items to increase Support Value.

◆ There is a chance to collect flowers after the performance ends. You can use flowers to attract fairies, which provide different temporary buffs. The drop rate of flowers is also related to the Heat Level.

◆ Your consumption of Performance Permits will be converted into Wish Coins, which can be used for Thalia Gacha pulls.

Seats

◆ Fans or support items deployed in seats can increase the Support Value.

◆ You need to use Performance Points to unlock seats.

◆ The more seats unlocked, the more support items can be deployed.

Fans

◆ Each fan has two attributes: base Support Value and Range Bonus. The Range Bonus refers to the additional Support Value given to other fans.

◆ Each fan's Range Bonus has different effective range. Only fans in corresponding range can receive the Range Bonus.

◆ You can use Performance Points to upgrade fans level, which will improve fan's base Support Value and Range Bonus.

◆ Fans can be removed, and removed fans will return all Performance Points previously used for their upgrade.

◆ Fans can be locked and unlocked, and locked fans will not appear on the remove list.

Support Items

◆ Each Support Item has only one attribute: Range Bonus.

◆ Each Support Item's Range Bonus only affect fans, not other Support Items.

◆ Each Support Item's Range Bonus only affects specific range. Only fans in corresponding range can receive the Range Bonus.

◆ There is a chance to get support items after the performance ends, and support items can be enhanced through their fragments.

Fairies

◆ There is a chance to collect flowers after the performance ends.

◆ You can combine different flowers to attract different fairies.

◆ Using fairies can provide different temporary buffs.

◆ Different fairies can be used together, and their temporary buffs do not interfere with each other.

◆ The same fairies can be used multiple times, which will extend the duration of the buffs.

Achievement Rewards

◆ During the event, when the consumption of Stamina reaches a certain value, you can earn rewards.

◆ The consumption of Stamina will be reset after the event ends. Transcenders need to consume stamina from zero to claim corresponding rewards.

Thalia Gacha Machine

◆ You will receive a certain number of Wish Coins after each performance.

◆ Wish Coins can be used to draw prizes.

◆ When the event enters the settlement period, all unused Stamina will automatically convert into Wish Coins.

◆ Once the event's claim period ends, unused Wish Coins will automatically be converted into rewards, which will be sent to you via mail.

Ranking

◆ There are two leaderboards during the event period: the Stamina Consumption Ranking and the Support Value Ranking.

◆ The more Stamina consumed, the higher the rank. If the number of consumed Stamina is the same, the ranking will be determined by the time of achievement, with earlier achievers ranking higher.

◆ The higher the Performance Heat Level, the higher the rank. If the heat level is the same, the ranking will be determined by historical Support Value, with higher values ranking higher. If both are the same, the earlier achievers will rank higher.

Reward Set selection is server/runtime dependent; all statically configured sets are shown.

P
Personal Ranking

◆ There are two leaderboards during the event period: the Stamina Consumption Ranking and the Support Value Ranking.

◆ The more Stamina consumed, the higher the rank. If the number of consumed Stamina is the same, the ranking will be determined by the time of achievement, with earlier achievers ranking higher.

◆ The higher the Performance Heat Level, the higher the rank. If the heat level is the same, the ranking will be determined by historical Support Value, with higher values ranking higher. If both are the same, the earlier achievers will rank higher.

P
Personal Ranking

◆ There are two leaderboards during the event period: the Stamina Consumption Ranking and the Support Value Ranking.

◆ The more Stamina consumed, the higher the rank. If the number of consumed Stamina is the same, the ranking will be determined by the time of achievement, with earlier achievers ranking higher.

◆ The higher the Performance Heat Level, the higher the rank. If the heat level is the same, the ranking will be determined by historical Support Value, with higher values ranking higher. If both are the same, the earlier achievers will rank higher.

P
Personal Ranking

◆ There are two leaderboards during the event period: the Stamina Consumption Ranking and the Support Value Ranking.

◆ The more Stamina consumed, the higher the rank. If the number of consumed Stamina is the same, the ranking will be determined by the time of achievement, with earlier achievers ranking higher.

◆ The higher the Performance Heat Level, the higher the rank. If the heat level is the same, the ranking will be determined by historical Support Value, with higher values ranking higher. If both are the same, the earlier achievers will rank higher.

Reward Set selection is server/runtime dependent; all statically configured sets are shown.

P
Personal Ranking

◆ There are two leaderboards during the event period: the Stamina Consumption Ranking and the Support Value Ranking.

◆ The more Stamina consumed, the higher the rank. If the number of consumed Stamina is the same, the ranking will be determined by the time of achievement, with earlier achievers ranking higher.

◆ The higher the Performance Heat Level, the higher the rank. If the heat level is the same, the ranking will be determined by historical Support Value, with higher values ranking higher. If both are the same, the earlier achievers will rank higher.

P
Personal Ranking

◆ There are two leaderboards during the event period: the Stamina Consumption Ranking and the Support Value Ranking.

◆ The more Stamina consumed, the higher the rank. If the number of consumed Stamina is the same, the ranking will be determined by the time of achievement, with earlier achievers ranking higher.

◆ The higher the Performance Heat Level, the higher the rank. If the heat level is the same, the ranking will be determined by historical Support Value, with higher values ranking higher. If both are the same, the earlier achievers will rank higher.
